data.title: Vehicle re-registration appointment confirmation (Terminbestätigung Umschreibung Fahrzeug)
data.summary: The Zulassungsstelle (vehicle registration office) of Kreis Beispielförde confirms a Saturday-service appointment for Finn Beispielsen on 7 March 2026 at 10:00 (counter 2) to re-register (Umschreibung) a vehicle, with a fee of about €37.60.
data.explanation: This letter confirms a booked appointment (Termin) at the vehicle registration office to re-register a car. Bring the vehicle registration certificates (Zulassungsbescheinigung Teil I and II), your insurance's eVB number, a SEPA mandate for the vehicle tax, and your ID card. The fee of about €37.60 is paid on site. If you cannot make the appointment, contact the office beforehand to reschedule; the letter does not state what happens otherwise.
